title: Introduction and Purpose
content:
IPC-A-610, officially titled "Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies," is a globally used visual acceptance standard for electronic assemblies and PCB assemblies (PCBA).
It provides visual acceptance criteria intended to support product quality, reliability, and consistency.
It is used for operator, inspector, and engineer training; certification validates personnel skill levels and quality commitment.
The standard is maintained through dedicated task groups and expert committees, alongside related standards such as J-STD-001.
keywords: IPC-A-610, Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies, PCBA, visual acceptance, certification
question_predict: IPC-A-610 的主要用途和适用对象是什么？
reference_answer: IPC-A-610 是电子组件和 PCBA 的目视验收标准，用于统一质量、可靠性和一致性判定，主要服务于制造、检验、工程及相关人员培训。

title: IPC-A-610 Coverage
content:
IPC-A-610 establishes measurable criteria for assessing PCBA suitability and expected longevity.
Covered areas include component placement, soldering quality for SMT/through-hole/mixed technology, post-assembly cleanliness, and marking/labeling for traceability.
Systematic inspection against these criteria supports objective evaluation of functional and aesthetic assembly requirements.
keywords: PCBA, component placement, soldering quality, cleanliness, marking, traceability
question_predict: IPC-A-610 通常覆盖哪些 PCBA 检验项目？
reference_answer: 通常覆盖元件贴装、通孔/SMT/混装焊接质量、焊后清洁，以及用于追溯的标记和标签。

title: Users of the Standard
content:
IPC-A-610 supports electronics manufacturers and assembly houses in defining internal PCBA quality-control processes.
It supports inspection organizations in conducting unbiased assessments.
It also gives customers and suppliers a shared basis for quality requirements and acceptance criteria.
The standard is updated to address evolving needs in industries including aerospace, automotive, and medical-device PCBA manufacturing.
keywords: quality control, inspection, supplier, aerospace, automotive, medical device
question_predict: 哪些组织或角色会使用 IPC-A-610？
reference_answer: 电子制造商、组装厂、第三方检验机构、客户和供应商都会使用 IPC-A-610，并广泛用于航空、汽车和医疗电子等行业。

title: PCBA Acceptance Criteria Framework
content:
The guide describes PCBA evaluation as based on inspection and evaluation parameters covering component placement, soldering accuracy, cleaning levels, and marking regulations.
The criteria apply to through-hole, surface-mount, and mixed-technology assemblies.
keywords: acceptance criteria, inspection, through-hole, SMT, mixed technology
question_predict: 该指南对 PCBA 的验收主要依据哪些参数？
reference_answer: PCBA 验收主要依据元件放置、焊接准确性、清洁程度和标记规范，并分别适用于通孔、表面贴装和混装组件。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 2 PCBA Acceptance Criteria > 2.1 Through-Hole
title: Through-Hole Component Requirements
content:
For through-hole assemblies, component orientation, spacing, and alignment on the PCB substrate should be correct.
Components should be securely mounted to withstand operational strain, and lead length should be sufficient for robust soldering.
Unacceptable conditions described include damaged component leads or PCB lands, excessive solder, solder bridging, cold solder joints, and visible cracks or fractures in solder joints.
The guide also emphasizes lead protrusion, solder wetting, and component alignment.
keywords: through-hole, THT, lead protrusion, solder wetting, solder bridging, cold solder joint
question_predict: 通孔元件焊接中，哪些情况会被视为不符合要求？
reference_answer: 不符合项包括元件方向、间距或对齐错误，安装不牢或引脚长度不足，以及引脚/焊盘损伤、焊锡过多、桥连、冷焊和焊点裂纹。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 2 PCBA Acceptance Criteria > 2.2 Surface Mount
title: Surface-Mount Component Requirements
content:
For surface-mount assemblies, components should have proper orientation, spacing, and alignment.
Components, the PCB, and solder joints should not be damaged during assembly.
Solder joints should exhibit proper wetting and fillet formation.
Conditions described as unacceptable include visible voids, excessive solder, solder bridging, and lifted, tilted, or misaligned components.
Inspection focuses on parameters such as fillet height, toe/heel overhang, and solder-paste coverage.
keywords: SMT, surface mount, fillet height, toe overhang, heel overhang, void, bridging
question_predict: SMT 元件出现倾斜、桥连或空洞时如何判定？
reference_answer: 可见空洞、焊锡过多、桥连，以及元件翘起、倾斜或错位均属于不可接受状态；同时还应检查润湿、焊脚形状和悬伸等参数。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 2 PCBA Acceptance Criteria > 2.3 Mixed Technology
title: Mixed-Technology Assembly Requirements
content:
For mixed-technology assemblies, acceptance requirements combine the through-hole and surface-mount requirements.
Through-hole components must be properly mounted and soldered.
Surface-mount components must have proper solder-joint formation and correct component orientation.
The guide describes reliable mixed-technology assembly as requiring balanced application of both THT and SMT standards.
keywords: mixed technology, THT, SMT, mounting, solder joint, orientation
question_predict: 混装 PCB 应如何同时满足通孔和 SMT 的验收要求？
reference_answer: 混装 PCB 应同时应用 THT 与 SMT 要求：通孔元件需安装牢固并正确焊接，SMT 元件需方向正确且焊点成形良好。

title: Component Placement Requirements
content:
Component placement criteria are intended to ensure correct assembly and fitness for intended use.
Failure to meet placement criteria can create assembly defects and affect finished-product functionality and reliability.
The requirements apply to through-hole, surface-mount, and mixed-technology assemblies.
keywords: component placement, assembly defect, reliability, PCBA
question_predict: 元件贴装不符合要求会对产品造成什么影响？
reference_answer: 贴装不合格会造成装配缺陷，并降低成品的功能、可靠性以及对预期用途的适用性。

title: Component Orientation
content:
Component orientation should match the direction specified in assembly documentation.
All components should be properly aligned.
The orientation of polarized components, including electrolytic capacitors and diodes, should be verified.
keywords: component orientation, polarized component, electrolytic capacitor, diode, alignment
question_predict: 极性元件的方向检验应关注哪些内容？
reference_answer: 应核对元件方向是否符合装配文件、整体是否对齐，并重点确认电解电容和二极管等极性元件的正负方向。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 3 Component Placement > 3.2 Spacing and Mounting
title: Spacing, Alignment, and Mounting
content:
Components should be placed with correct spacing and alignment to provide clearance, avoid mechanical interference, and leave adequate room for assembly and testing.
Components should be securely mounted; all leads or pads should be properly inserted or seated.
Leads or pads should not be damaged during insertion, and components should be held in place until soldered.
keywords: spacing, alignment, clearance, mechanical interference, mounting, seated lead
question_predict: 元件间距和安装牢固性有哪些基本要求？
reference_answer: 元件应保持正确间距和对齐，避免机械干涉并留出装配测试空间；安装必须牢固，引脚或焊盘应正确就位且不得受损。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 3 Component Placement > 3.3 Through-Hole Placement
title: Through-Hole Lead Placement
content:
For through-hole components, leads should be trimmed and bent to the correct length and angle to support proper solder-joint formation.
Leads should be flush with the PCB surface to avoid mechanical interference with other components.
keywords: through-hole lead, trimming, bending, lead length, mechanical interference
question_predict: 通孔元件引脚为什么需要按正确长度和角度修剪、弯折？
reference_answer: 正确修剪和弯折可保证焊点正常成形，并使引脚贴近 PCB 表面，避免与其他元件发生机械干涉。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 3 Component Placement > 3.4 SMT Placement
title: Surface-Mount Placement
content:
For surface-mount components, placement should be accurate and consistent, with proper alignment and spacing.
Component orientation should be verified before soldering to confirm that the component is correctly placed.
keywords: SMT placement, alignment, spacing, orientation verification
question_predict: SMT 元件在焊接前需要确认哪些贴装条件？
reference_answer: 焊接前应确认 SMT 元件贴装准确且一致，间距和对齐正确，并核实元件方向无误。

title: Soldering Requirements
content:
Soldering criteria apply to through-hole, surface-mount, and combined-technology assemblies.
The guide identifies solder-joint formation, fillet, joint shape, cleanliness, and mechanical strength as key evaluation aspects.
The criteria are intended to ensure assemblies meet quality requirements for their intended use.
keywords: soldering, solder joint, fillet, cleanliness, mechanical strength
question_predict: 焊点检验通常应包含哪些关键项目？
reference_answer: 焊点检验通常包括焊点成形、焊锡弯月面、焊点外形、清洁度和机械强度。

title: Solder Joint Formation
content:
The solder joint should be consistent and uniform.
It should have no voids, excessive solder, or solder bridging.
Solder should completely wet the pad or lead surface to provide a strong, reliable joint.
keywords: solder joint formation, wetting, void, excessive solder, bridging
question_predict: 什么样的焊点形成可视为可靠？
reference_answer: 可靠焊点应均匀一致、焊锡充分润湿焊盘或引脚，并且没有空洞、焊锡过多或桥连。

title: Solder Joint Fillet
content:
The solder-joint fillet should be smooth and concave.
A visible transition should be present between the pad or lead surface and the solder.
The fillet should be continuous and uniform around the entire joint perimeter.
keywords: solder fillet, concave fillet, wetting transition, continuous fillet
question_predict: 可靠焊点的焊锡弯月面应具备哪些外观特征？
reference_answer: 焊锡弯月面应平滑、内凹，在焊盘或引脚与焊锡之间有清晰过渡，并围绕整个焊点保持连续和均匀。

title: Solder Joint Shape
content:
Solder-joint shape should suit the component type and intended assembly use.
For through-hole components, the solder joint should be barrel-shaped.
For surface-mount components, the solder joint should be flat or slightly concave.
keywords: solder joint shape, barrel-shaped, through-hole, SMT, concave
question_predict: 通孔焊点和 SMT 焊点的推荐外形有什么区别？
reference_answer: 通孔焊点推荐呈桶形；SMT 焊点推荐呈平坦或轻微内凹形。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 4 Soldering > 4.4 Cleanliness and Strength
title: Solder Cleanliness and Strength
content:
The solder joint and surrounding area should be free from flux residues, debris, and other contaminants that could affect joint reliability.
The solder joint should be mechanically strong and sound, with no visible cracks or fractures.
The joint should withstand stresses and strains from assembly, testing, and use.
keywords: flux residue, contamination, crack, fracture, solder joint strength
question_predict: 焊点周围的残留物和裂纹会如何影响验收？
reference_answer: 助焊剂残留、碎屑等污染物会降低可靠性；可见裂纹或断裂说明机械强度不足，焊点不能通过验收。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 5 Cleaning and Coating > 5.1 Cleaning
title: Cleaning Requirements for PCBA
content:
The assembly should be cleaned after soldering to remove flux residues, debris, and other contaminants that can affect assembly reliability.
The selected cleaning method should suit the assembly type.
The cleaning agent should not damage the assembly or its components.
keywords: PCBA cleaning, flux residue, debris, cleaning agent, contamination
question_predict: PCBA 焊后清洗应满足哪些基本要求？
reference_answer: 焊后应去除助焊剂残留、碎屑和其他污染物；清洗方法要适合组件类型，清洗剂不得损伤组件或元器件。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 5 Cleaning and Coating > 5.2 Conformal Coating
title: Conformal Coating Requirements
content:
An assembly may be protected with conformal coating against moisture, dust, and chemical exposure.
The coating should be applied uniformly and consistently.
Voids, bubbles, and other coating defects that can affect assembly reliability should not be present.
keywords: conformal coating, moisture, dust, chemical exposure, void, bubble
question_predict: 三防漆涂覆出现气泡或空洞时有什么风险？
reference_answer: 气泡和空洞会破坏涂层的均匀与连续保护，削弱防潮、防尘和耐化学暴露能力，从而影响组件可靠性。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 5 Cleaning and Coating > 5.3 Thickness and Material
title: Coating Thickness and Material
content:
Coating thickness should be appropriate to the intended use of the assembly and should not affect assembly functionality or performance.
Thickness may be measured with appropriate tools and should be within the acceptable range.
Coating material should suit the assembly type and intended use, be compatible with assembly materials, and not affect functionality or reliability.
keywords: coating thickness, coating material, compatibility, conformal coating, measurement
question_predict: 如何判断三防漆厚度和材料是否适合该 PCBA？
reference_answer: 厚度应符合预期用途和允许范围且不影响功能；材料应适配组件类型与使用环境、兼容组件材料，并且不损害性能和可靠性。

title: Marking and Labeling Requirements
content:
Marking and labeling support identification and traceability of the complete assembly and its components.
The guide applies these requirements to through-hole, surface-mount, and mixed-technology electronic assemblies.
keywords: marking, labeling, identification, traceability, PCBA
question_predict: PCB 和组件标识为何是验收与追溯的重要部分？
reference_answer: 标记和标签为整机及其元件提供身份识别和追溯依据，因此是验收、问题定位和质量追踪的重要组成部分。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 6 Marking and Labeling > 6.1 Identification
title: Component, PCB, and Assembly Marking
content:
Components, PCBs, and completed assemblies should carry appropriate identification codes or symbols to enable identification and traceability.
Marking should be legible, permanent, and located in a visible area of the relevant component, PCB, or assembly.
keywords: component marking, PCB marking, assembly marking, legibility, permanence, traceability
question_predict: 元件、PCB 和整机标识需要满足哪些共同要求？
reference_answer: 元件、PCB 和整机都应带有可识别和追溯的代码或符号；标识应清晰、永久并位于可见位置。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 6 Marking and Labeling > 6.2 Labels and Orientation
title: Labels, Location, and Orientation Marking
content:
An assembly may require labels that provide additional information or instructions to the end user.
Labels should be legible, permanent, and placed in a visible area of the assembly.
Component location and orientation should be marked on the PCB to enable accurate placement and support functional reliability.
keywords: labeling, location marking, orientation marking, legible, permanent
question_predict: PCB 上的位置和方向标识有什么作用？
reference_answer: 位置和方向标识用于指导元件准确贴装、避免方向错误，并支持最终产品的功能可靠性。

title: Training and Certification Requirements
content: IPC-A-610 training and certification are intended to ensure that personnel involved in electronic-assembly production have the knowledge and skills required to perform their work effectively and to the required quality level.
keywords: training, certification, IPC-A-610, personnel qualification, electronics assembly
question_predict: IPC-A-610 培训与认证的目标是什么？
reference_answer: 培训与认证旨在确保电子装配生产人员具备按规定质量水平有效完成工作的知识和技能。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 7 Training and Certification > 7.1 Program and Recertification
title: Training, Certification, and Recertification
content:
Training should cover relevant IPC-A-610 topics and criteria and be delivered by certified trainers or training centers.
Training may include classroom instruction, practical exercises, and examinations.
Certification examinations assess knowledge and skills and may have different levels based on job function and responsibilities.
Certified personnel may require periodic recertification to maintain current knowledge and skills.
keywords: training program, certification exam, recertification, certified trainer, practical exercise
question_predict: IPC-A-610 认证培训通常包含哪些环节？
reference_answer: 通常包括认证讲师或培训中心授课、课堂教学、实践练习、考试与分级认证，并通过定期再认证保持知识和技能有效。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 7 Training and Certification > 7.2 Records
title: Training Records
content:
Training records should be maintained for every individual who receives IPC-A-610 training and certification.
Records should include the individual's name, training date, certification date, certification level, and other relevant information.
keywords: training records, certification record, certification level, traceability
question_predict: IPC-A-610 培训记录至少应保留哪些信息？
reference_answer: 至少应记录受训人员姓名、培训日期、认证日期、认证等级及其他相关信息。

title: Class 2 and Class 3
content:
Class 2 covers dedicated-service electronic products for which continued performance and extended life are required, but uninterrupted service is not critical; examples include computers and household appliances.
Class 3 covers high-performance or harsh-environment products for mission-critical applications where downtime is not acceptable; examples include medical life support, aerospace, and military systems.
The guide states that Class 3 requires more inspection and stricter tolerances, giving through-hole vertical solder fill of 75% for Class 3 compared with 50% for Class 2.
keywords: Class 2, Class 3, through-hole fill, high reliability, aerospace, medical
question_predict: IPC Class 2 和 Class 3 的关键差异是什么？
reference_answer: Class 2 面向要求持续性能和较长寿命、但不中断运行并非关键的专用产品；Class 3 面向任务关键或恶劣环境产品，容差更严、检验更多，通孔填充要求也更高。

hierarchy: IPC-A-610 Guide > 8 FAQ > 8.2 BGA and QFN Voiding
title: Solder Voiding in BGA and QFN
content:
The guide states that a void in a BGA joint is generally acceptable when it occupies less than 25% of the total solder-ball area.
For QFN thermal pads, requirements may vary according to heat-dissipation needs.
Although 25% is presented as a general rule of thumb, high-power applications may require stricter limits to prevent overheating.
keywords: BGA void, QFN thermal pad, solder voiding, X-ray, 25 percent
question_predict: BGA 焊点空洞面积低于 25% 是否可以接受？
reference_answer: 通常可以接受，因为一般规则是 BGA 空洞面积小于焊球总面积的 25%；但高功率应用可能需要更严格的限制。

title: Component Misalignment and Overhang
content:
The guide states that component misalignment is not always a defect.
Depending on class and component type, side overhang of up to 25% or 50% of component width may be acceptable.
A slight misalignment is often acceptable when minimum electrical clearance is maintained and the solder joint remains robust.
keywords: component misalignment, overhang, electrical clearance, acceptable, defect
question_predict: 元件侧向悬伸在什么条件下仍可接受？
reference_answer: 侧向悬伸是否可接受取决于产品等级和元件类型，通常上限为元件宽度的 25% 或 50%；同时必须保持最小电气间隙且焊点牢固。

title: No-Clean Flux Residues
content:
No-clean flux residues are described as acceptable when they are non-corrosive, non-conductive, and do not interfere with visual inspection or testing.
In high-humidity environments, even no-clean residue can contribute to electrochemical migration (ECM) or dendritic growth; the guide recommends professional cleaning for harsh operating conditions regardless of flux type.
keywords: no-clean flux, flux residue, non-corrosive, ECM, dendritic growth, humidity
question_predict: 免清洗助焊剂残留在什么情况下仍需清洗？
reference_answer: 当组件处于高湿度或其他恶劣工作环境、残留可能引发电化学迁移或枝晶生长时，即使是免清洗助焊剂也建议进行专业清洗。

title: Visual Acceptance Versus Process Control
content:
IPC-A-610 is described as a visual acceptance standard that defines the required appearance of the final product.
It does not prescribe the manufacturing process; the guide identifies IPC-J-STD-001 as the standard that addresses how assemblies are built.
IPC-A-610 therefore serves as a quality checklist for assessing whether delivered boards meet visual reliability benchmarks.
keywords: visual acceptance, process control, IPC-J-STD-001, inspection checklist
question_predict: IPC-A-610 与 IPC-J-STD-001 在用途上有什么区别？
reference_answer: IPC-A-610 规定成品应达到的目视验收外观，用于判断交付板是否合格；IPC-J-STD-001 规定组件应如何制造和焊接，侧重过程要求。

content:

keywords: Class 1, Class 2, Class 3, through-hole fill, overhang, inspection rigor
question_predict: IPC Class 1、2、3 在通孔填充和检验严格度上如何比较？
reference_answer: Class 1 要求最宽松且通孔填充未明确；Class 2 通孔填充至少 50%、检验较全面；Class 3 至少 75%、容差最严，并采用 100% 检验或 X-Ray。
